market_pulse.theme: Increasing regulatory and tax pressure on UK gambling operators
market_pulse.narrative: UK operators are facing a wave of new taxes (Remote Gaming Duty, Machine Games Duty) and regulatory scrutiny, leading to profit pressure, disputes with the Treasury, and strategic reassessments.

market_pulse.theme: Impact of prediction markets on gambling operators
market_pulse.narrative: The rise of prediction markets and related regulatory actions are influencing operator valuations, product strategies, and market sentiment for firms such as Kalshi, DraftKings, and RSI.

market_pulse.theme: Strategic partnerships and market expansion initiatives
market_pulse.narrative: Operators are accelerating growth by forming distribution partnerships, entering new jurisdictions, and launching new B2B products, exemplified by collaborations with IGT, Endorphina, SOFTSWISS, GR8_TECH, and LSports.

market_pulse.theme: Regional regulatory developments and market growth
market_pulse.narrative: Several regions are updating gambling regulations, automating lottery payouts, and tightening enforcement, affecting market dynamics in South Korea, Africa, Zimbabwe, South Africa, Mauritius, and India (Goa).

market_pulse.theme: Free‑to‑play and prediction‑market products facing regulatory scrutiny
market_pulse.narrative: Operators such as Entain are launching free‑to‑play football games while Kalshi rolls out an election hub. At the same time regulators in France, Ireland and California are tightening rules on prediction markets, leading to lawsuits and heightened compliance pressure.
